The problem

Jobs don’t go over budget in one big moment

They drift — a missed delivery here, an old drawing there, a change order nobody logged. Constinex catches the drift while it’s still cheap to fix.

The old way

  • Schedules living in spreadsheets nobody on site ever sees
  • Budgets updated at month-end — weeks after the money is spent
  • Drawings, RFIs and approvals buried in email threads
  • Daily logs on paper, re-typed (or lost) back at the office
  • Change orders agreed verbally, argued about at payment time

With Constinex

  • One live schedule the whole project — office and field — works from
  • Costs committed in real time, so forecasts are never a surprise
  • Every document versioned, searchable, and tied to the task it affects
  • Foremen log the day from their phone in under five minutes
  • Change orders priced, approved and tracked before work starts

Platform

Everything a project needs, in one system

Six connected modules. No double entry, no exporting between tools — an update in one place updates everywhere.

Scheduling & planning

Gantt schedules, lookaheads and task dependencies that foremen actually follow — with delays flagged the moment a predecessor slips.

Budget & cost control

Job costing, commitments, change orders and payment applications in one ledger. See forecast-at-completion on every cost code, live.

Crews & subcontractors

Assignments, certifications, timesheets and a free portal for subs to submit bids, documents, daily reports and invoices.

Field app & daily logs

Daily logs, photos, punch lists and inspections from any phone — even offline. Everything syncs when signal returns.

Documents, RFIs & submittals

One version-controlled home for drawings and specs. RFIs and submittals tracked with owners, due dates and ball-in-court.

Safety & compliance

Inspections, incident reports, toolbox talks and permit tracking — with a complete audit trail when regulators or insurers ask.

Platform

A construction ERP, not a pile of apps

Constinex combines standard Odoo business applications with specialized construction modules and workflows — one database, one login, one version of the truth from inquiry to handover. Constinex is the product and the brand; Odoo is the proven foundation underneath it.

Built on Odoo

  • CRM, sales, purchasing, inventory, invoicing and user management come from Odoo’s mature business applications.
  • Construction-specific workflows — estimating, BOQ, project structures, cost codes — are Constinex modules built for how builders actually work.
  • Role-based access, audit trails, notifications and document management run across every module.

Honest about readiness

  • Every module below carries a status: In development means a partial implementation exists today; Planned means it is on the roadmap and still being verified against the live implementation.
  • Construction Core and Estimation & BOQ are the furthest along — project structures, estimation approvals, quotation creation and estimate-to-budget conversion are already implemented in part.
  • Demonstrations on this page are illustrative and use one consistent sample project: Harbor Point — Tower B.

How it works

Live on your next project in three steps

STEP 01

Set up the job

Import your budget and schedule from Excel, Primavera or MS Project — or start from templates for common project types. Most teams are set up the same day.

STEP 02

Bring the team in

Invite your office, field crews and subcontractors. Everyone sees only what’s relevant to them, and subs join free on the portal.

STEP 03

Run it daily

Field logs feed the schedule, the schedule feeds the forecast, and you get a clear morning brief: what changed, what’s at risk, what needs a decision.

Questions

Frequently asked

How long does it take to get set up?

Most companies run their first project the same day. Import a budget or schedule from Excel, Primavera P6 or MS Project, invite your team, and you’re live. Enterprise plans include hands-on onboarding and training.

Does it work for subcontractors, or just GCs?

Both. Trade contractors use Constinex to manage their own crews, bids and billing — and join GC projects free through the subcontractor portal, so there’s no cost barrier to keeping everyone on one system.

What happens when there’s no signal on site?

The field app is offline-first. Logs, photos, inspections and punch items are captured locally and sync automatically when a connection returns.

Can it connect to our accounting system?

Professional and Enterprise plans integrate with common accounting and ERP tools, and Enterprise includes full API access so committed costs and payments stay in sync with finance.

Is our project data secure — and can we take it with us?

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with role-based access per project. And yes: you can export everything — documents, logs, financials — at any time. Your data is yours.

Is Constinex just Odoo?

No. Constinex is the product and the brand. It combines standard Odoo business applications (CRM, purchasing, invoicing, users) with Constinex construction modules and workflows — estimating & BOQ, project structures, cost codes and more — configured as one construction ERP.

Which modules are ready today?

Construction Core and Estimation & BOQ are in development, with partial implementations already in place — project structures, estimation approvals, quotation creation and estimate-to-budget conversion. The remaining construction-specific capabilities are planned and are being verified against the live implementation before being offered as production-ready, which is why each module on this page carries a status.

What is the Founding Customer Programme?

Our first three customers receive a free professional website and free Constinex construction management software. Places are confirmed individually during application — apply through the contact section above.

What does the free trial include?

14 days of the Professional plan, full access, no credit card. Run a real project on it — that’s the fastest way to see the value.
